meta.signal: Apple is reported to be expanding AI hiring in India (Sept 2026) and OpenAI is reported to be hiring AI engineers in Delhi and Mumbai. Neither article could be opened, so both are unverified; check the careers pages. Roles that combine UI and agentic work remain scarce, since most agentic listings are Python or backend.

regions.India: AssetIntel and Raochra are the closest direct matches. The 65+ India agentic listings are almost all Python/LLM roles, not UI.
regions.Japan (English): Money Forward (Tokyo) and Metanomaly list no Japanese requirement and are partially remote. HENNGE offers visa sponsorship. Confirm seniority and sponsorship on each page.
regions.Canada / USA: Mattermost, GC AI, HIFI Labs, Fredrin and Curai hire in North America. Several need US-hours overlap, which is night time in IST.
regions.Australia: No verified remote UI plus agentic role found. Seek blocks automated reads, so check Seek and LinkedIn Australia directly. Umbrel (worldwide) is open from Australia.
regions.Africa: DeepSource (Egypt remote, AI company), Yellow Card and Umbrel are open. DuckDuckGo also hires remote across Africa. India-based remote roles in Africa-only listings are not eligible.
regions.Saudi Arabia: No verified remote UI plus agentic role today. Your SABIC KSA project experience is a plus when you apply.

meta.boards: Scanned through public pages and search results: reactjobs.io, onlyfrontendjobs, Arc, Himalayas, agentic-engineering-jobs, Hacker News Who is Hiring, TokyoDev, Japan Dev, hiddenjobs.dev, company careers pages. Added regions: Remote Rocketship (Africa), Indeed Nigeria, Glassdoor Australia. Could not scan (login wall, 403 or robots.txt): LinkedIn and Naukri job feeds, Seek, parts of Bayt.
